BRUKINSA was approved by the FDA on 14 November 2019 and launched in the United States that month, so 2019Q4 is the first quarter of sales. The fiscal 2019 Form 10-K and fourth-quarter 2019 release state only that U.S. product revenues were not significant and print no BRUKINSA figure.

gold_notes: The third-quarter 2014 earnings release (accession 0001104659-14-073810) does not print Keytruda sales (the product is not on its sales table; its text reports the 4 September 2014 FDA approval and first shipments only). The fourth-quarter and full-year 2014 release prints Keytruda's four 2014 quarters as separate columns of the same sales table: 0, 0, 4, 50 and a full year of 55 (the printed full year is one more than the quarters' sum, a rounding difference). The third quarter of 2014 is the 3Q column of that row (the third of the four quarterly columns). Merck's quarterly earnings release (8-K exhibit 99.1) prints this product on its own 'Keytruda' line of the multi-column sales table (worldwide sales, USD millions, no regional split; columns are the current-year quarters and year-to-date, then the prior-year quarters, then percentage changes). The line is Merck's worldwide sales of Keytruda (pembrolizumab) and carries no footnote adding other products. From the fourth-quarter 2025 release Merck prints the intravenous product on a 'Keytruda' line and the subcutaneous product on a separate 'Keytruda Qlex' line, and the summary table headline becomes 'KEYTRUDA/KEYTRUDA QLEX'; this series is the 'Keytruda' line only, whose earlier values are unchanged, and it excludes Keytruda Qlex sales.

Rezdiffra (resmetirom) is Madrigal's only commercial product, so product revenue, net is Rezdiffra net sales (the quarterly earnings releases call the same amounts 'Rezdiffra net sales'). Madrigal's FY2025 Form 10-K states it launched Rezdiffra in the United States in April 2024 and in Germany in September 2025, so the line is U.S. only until the third quarter of 2025 and includes Germany after that. Derived: full year 2025 958,403 (Form 10-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1157601/000162828026009514/mdgl-20251231.htm) less nine months 2025 637,320 (third-quarter Form 10-Q, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1157601/000162828025048559/mdgl-20250930.htm) = 321083 thousand USD; both inputs printed to the thousand, so exact. The fourth-quarter 2025 release (8-K exhibit, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1157601/000162828026009476/exhibit991.htm) states $321.1 million in text but has no table.

gold_notes: J&J states this product on its own line of the Major Pharmaceutical Product Revenues table in its Form 10-Q. Each 10-Q prints two of these tables - the fiscal year to date and the fiscal quarter on its own - and the quarter is read from the second, so no arithmetic is needed. A fourth quarter is never filed as a quarter, and is the 10-K's full year less the nine months the third-quarter 10-Q states. The table first appears in the first-quarter 2005 10-Q; before that the 10-Qs name products only in prose and state no product-level figures at all.
